title: Design: A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1536 px: no overlap or clipping, light and dark
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location column shows.
  • Have a vendor with a long name (more than 40 characters) and open documents at both locations on today's date, including a vendor credit (its Transaction Type is the longest), so the page shows a long name and a long Transaction Type, which must not overlap or be cut off.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1536 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
  • Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) in a second tab of the same window, for comparison.

Setup

  1. Locations to use: Use "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" as location A (it comes first in A to Z order) and "Staging Lethbridge - 4310" as location B. To work at location B, click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Change Location, then "Staging Lethbridge - 4310"; switch back to "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" the same way when you are done.
  2. Make vendor A: Click Parts in the top bar, then Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor. Type the Name ZZAUTOTEST Northern Alberta Heavy Haul and Towing Ltd (more than 40 characters), pick Credit Terms "Net 30" and Taxes "Exempt (0%)", then click Save & Close.
  3. Make bill 1: Click Parts in the top bar, then Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO. Pick vendor A in Vendor. In Part Number type a new part number and click "Add new special order part: …"; type a Description, 1 in Quantity and 300.00 in Cost; click Add, then Save & Close. In the Purchase Orders list click Receive on that order (Vendor column: vendor A); type a Vendor Invoice # (for example bill 1), type today's date in Invoice Date, type 0 in Tax, then click Receive Parts (1).
  4. Make bill 2: While switched to location B (see the Locations to use item): Same way as bill 1, with vendor A in Vendor: Cost 200.00; type today's date in Invoice Date.
  5. Make vendor credit 1: Click Parts in the top bar, then Returns in the left menu, then Create Return. Pick vendor A in Vendor, type a Packaging Slip, pick the part received on bill 1 in Part Number, type 50.00 in Price Per Unit, then click Save Return. In the Returns list tick that return and click Receive Credit; type a Credit Memo Number, type today's date in Credit Date, type 0 in Tax, then click Post Credit.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the title row and the filter row.
  2. Read the column headings.
  3. Look for a sideways scroll bar below the last row of the report page.
  4. Look at the "Open Balance" column and the Totals row, and compare the Totals row with Sales By Customer's.
  5. Look across the page for overlap or clipping.
  6. Switch ShopView to dark theme.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Title, info icon and ⋯ on one line.
  • The filter row below.

Step 2:

  • Every heading on one line.

Step 3:

  • There is none.

Step 4:

  • "Open Balance" pinned to the right edge and bold.
  • Side by side, the Totals row looks the same as Sales By Customer's: the same background colour, text size and weight.

Step 5:

  • Nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped.

Step 6:

  • The page switches to dark theme with the same layout, links readable.
  • Nothing overlaps or is clipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R2: “The title, its info icon and the Export menu stay on one line at 1440 pixels wide; the filter row sits below them, positioned as on the native reports.”
  • S8-R3: “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction Type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns) and A/P Unpaid Invoices, column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.”
  • S8-R4: “The Totals row uses the native totals row style of the newer reports.”
  • S7-R7: “Links use the native report link style (the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline, underlined only on keyboard focus), readable in light and dark theme.”

Last checked against build v26.45.2-6a8b89c (QA site sv11315) on 11/10/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). The design pictures 1440 px only.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p6-a-p-unpaid-invoices-at-1440-every-column-visible.png: figure "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p6-a-p-detail-scrolled-sideways-light.png: figure "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light" (Production (before)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "At 1440 pixels every column fits without sideways scrolling: Date, Location, Transaction Type, No., Vendor Name, Due Date, Past Due, Amount and the pinned, bold Open Balance. Group labels span to the total; text columns wrap. S8-R3." (caption of "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible")
  • "No description anywhere; no column stays in place." (caption of "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light")

Difference from the PRD (DD-05), closed: PRD version 5 said "the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline" (S7-R7); the design shows document numbers and customer and vendor names are blue at the same (regular) weight as the plain text beside them. Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 15): semi-bold, exactly as Work In Progress links look today. The design's "Links only where they can open" picture was reshot on 23 Oct 2026 (round 15) and published on 5 Nov 2026; its caption now reads "Native link style: the Work In Progress blue, semi-bold, no underline." This case follows the PRD (S7-R7, unchanged in version 11). The held design-version case D-80 (C715562) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).

Difference from the PRD (DD-07), closed: PRD version 10 (4 Nov 2026) says Transaction Type "names each kind of credit: "Credit Memo" and "Deposit" on A/R, "Vendor Credit" on A/P" (S2-R1b); the design shows Transaction Type "Credit" on every credit memo, deposit and vendor credit row (for example in "Expand all from the header", "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices", "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible", "Cancel stays on the report" and "Vendor credits link"). Closed by the later PRD ruling: PRD version 10 (4 Nov 2026, Chris Ward, the design authority) added S2-R1b after these pictures were taken and lists it under What changes for existing users ("today all three read "Credit""); version 11 keeps it. Compare the layout with the pictures; the Transaction Type words come from the PRD.

Design note (DR-01): the design shows the Totals row sits on a light-grey band in some pictures (A/R Collection expanded, A/P Detail, A/P Unpaid Invoices, A/R Detail I32) and on the page colour in others (Summaries, I28, the same A/R Detail screen in I30). Closed without a question: PRD S8-R4: "The Totals row uses the native totals row style of the newer reports." The cases compare with Sales By Customer's Totals row; the pictures are not the reference for this one attribute.
